$comment: NIP-06 derivation vectors in the EXTENSION-COMPATIBLE layout: sub-account n is at
m/44'/1237'/0'/0/{n} — the LAST component varies, the account component stays at 0'.
This is NOT the m/44'/1237'/{n}'/0/0 that a strict reading of NIP-06 suggests, and the
difference is deliberate: the browser extension has shipped these paths to real users, and
a seed restored elsewhere must return the same identities. See packages/accounts/README.md.
Index 0 is the published NIP-06 test vector and is identical under either layout.
Generated from @nostr-wot/accounts. nostr-wot-extension is expected to gain a mirror test
reading this same file during its migration; keep the two copies byte-identical.
